method: Headless Chromium; immutable localhost gzip HTTP snapshot; fresh contexts per viewport; one sample per flow. Click clocks start in capture listeners and end at asserted DOM state. Reading/typing time and manual scroll gestures excluded.
limitations: Local transfer includes browser-reported headers; gzip file bytes are a separate estimate. Production CDN transfer is not measured.
JS heap is not total browser RAM. GPU memory, compositor process CPU and field INP are not measured.
Trace paint duration is renderer work, not GPU memory or visual frame correctness.
All top-level tabs and named critical flows are exercised; this is not every control or every content record.

profile_validation.method: Offscreen animation gate applied to the recorded trace/profile after baseline collection. No browser metrics were changed.
